en-US.description:
Your life and money are scattered across apps. Casberi gives you an inbox and a wallet for all your accounts, and soon, a rewards card for your subscriptions. Keep up with your feeds and finances on your iPhone, iPad and Mac, privately and with no server.

An inbox for all your apps.
More than 100 apps, sorted into the categories you live in: social, work, reading, media, mail, calendar and more. See them all together in one feed, or one app at a time. Apple's apps connect with one tap; other services with a read-only key.

A wallet for all your accounts.
Your wallets, exchanges, cards and cash add up to one number. See it all together, or one account at a time. Follow any wallet address without a key; following only reads.

Your own account.
Create it in a tap and sign with Face ID. Send, receive and swap on Ethereum, Base and Robinhood. Only you hold the key.

Buy with a card. Swap anything.
Buy USDC or ETH with a card, on Stripe's page. Swap any token in one sentence, even to another network. Every move is checked on the network before you sign, and Casberi adds no fee.

Send and receive privately.
Move money into your private balance with 0xBow Privacy Pools on Ethereum. Send privately, receive at a fresh address, and take a deposit back anytime while it waits for approval.

A private balance that earns.
Your private balance earns interest in Aave, and counts once in your total.

Round up your spare change.
Turn on Round-ups and the spare change from what you send is saved privately in dollars, in your private balance, where it earns.

See what you spend, and where.
Spending by place, every subscription and what it costs, and the fees you paid. Spend USDC on gift cards, powered by Bitrefill.

Catch threats before they cost you.
Casberi flags address poisoning, fake tokens and fake transfers, and shows every app that can spend from you.

Safe by design.
Your keys stay on your iPhone. Add a recovery key in iCloud Keychain and a co-signer for every send and swap. Every wallet request goes through Tor.

Your agents.
Bring a key for the agent you use, or connect your own model running on your own computer.

Try it first.
Casberi opens with a demo you can browse, wallet included. Clear it when you're ready and connect your own.

Yours.
No server, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking. Sync through your own iCloud. Export everything to one file, or delete it all for good.

en-US.description:
Everything you do is scattered across apps, agents, wallets. Casberi is an inbox for your apps and a wallet of your own. It all comes together on your Mac, iPhone and iPad, with no sign-up, no servers and no tracking.

A wallet of your own.
Create your account in a tap and sign with Touch ID. Send, receive and swap on Base, Ethereum and Robinhood Chain, and receive any token from another network, converted to the one you want. Only you hold the key: Casberi can never move your money.

Swap in one sentence.
"Swap $20 of USDC for ETH on Base." Fill in the blanks, see what you get, confirm with Touch ID. Every swap is checked on the network first, so one that would fail or pay less than quoted is never signed. Swaps are powered by Relay.

Buy gift cards with crypto.
Pick a category and a merchant, and pay with USDC from your account. No card to add and no store account to make. Powered by Bitrefill.

Safe by design.
Add a recovery key so a lost phone never means lost money, add a second signer, and set a spend limit. Round up your transactions and save the change in any token.

One wallet for all your money.
Your wallets, exchanges, cards, savings and cash add up to one number. Follow any wallet address without a key or a signature; following only reads. See what you hold, what you spend and what's at risk.

Every subscription, in one place.
See the newsletters and lists filling your inbox beside the software and services you pay for. What each one costs, when it renews, and which you haven't used in a month.

Follow the stocks behind your apps.
Every app you use is made by a company. Markets shows its stock or token, with a heat map of your day and price alerts.

Wallet, Work, Day, Life, Agents, Media, Social, Reading.
More than 90 apps, sorted into the categories you live in. Apple's apps connect with one tap; other services with a read-only key, so Casberi can see but never change.

One feed per category.
Everything in a category lands in one feed, newest first: a deploy that failed, a payment that landed, a reply, a meeting coming up.

Try it first.
Casberi opens with a demo you can browse, wallet included. Clear it when you're ready and connect your own.

Yours.
No server, no sign-up, no ads. Sync through your own iCloud. Export everything to one file, or delete it all for good.

Features
• Name each Wallet app's account on its Home
• Show what Acorns, Splits and Privy hold for you
• Sign in to Muse, ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and Gemini instead of pasting a key
• See your Claude Code cloud sessions and which ones need you

Design
• End every Feed + menu with the category's other apps

Fixes
• Fix "Nothing needs you" flashing when you pick an app

en-US.whatsNew:
Features
• Privacy scanning with Nymis
• Send or swap a token straight from its page in Wallet
• Open the Safe transaction waiting on you from Needs you
• Approve as co-signer with Base, Ambire, MetaMask, Rabby, Zerion, Rainbow or OKX
• Connect your banks and cards through SimpleFIN, each shown with its bank's logo
• Keep a watchlist of tokens in the Wallet, led by the day's biggest mover
• See what's ahead in Calendar: today, then each day to come
• See your account's no-signature allowance, read from the chain
• Resolve ENS names on chain
• Turn off your co-signer from this Mac, even if you've lost the wallet that holds it
• If your co-signer's wallet doesn't respond, switch to another wallet without starting over
• Open any chat in Telegram straight from Casberi

Design
• A new Feed where every item looks like the app it came from:
  – Telegram messages appear as chat bubbles
  – ChatGPT and Claude conversations show your question as a bubble
  – X and Bluesky posts show who posted, why you're seeing it, and what they said
  – Emails show the sender and the subject
  – GitHub, Linear, Jira and Sentry items show their repository or key, and their state
  – Calendar events show their hours and place, and say when they're cancelled
  – Newsletters, podcasts and videos show who published them
  – Kindle and Readwise highlights appear as quotes, with the book underneath
  – App Store reviews show their stars, and package releases their version
  – Workouts, Duolingo, Steam, songs and ENS names lead with their number
  – Files show their type and size
  – Your own notes appear in a serif font
• Posts open looking like the post itself
• Songs, podcasts and videos open with their art large
• Wallet receipts and subscriptions open with their art large
• Telegram channels now show forwarded posts, view counts and group photos
• See your whole week at a glance in Day
• Lead Permissions with the approval to look at
• Show Threats week by week
• Compare your watched tokens side by side
• Show your account's whole address, with Copy address
• Show your vault's folder icons in Notes
• New app icon
• Swaps, deposits and lends show what you did, with the app's logo in the corner
• Lending and private sends say who powers them

Fixes
• Aave and Spark loans show their own names
• Wise and Apple Wallet bank rows show their app's logo
• X posts from Following open as posts, with their pictures
• Fix Watch a token missing some tokens you hold
• Fix voice notes failing to transcribe some recordings
• Fix a thing's From card not saying what brought it in
• Fix Holdings' NFT chooser naming your account differently from Home
• Cancelling an approval no longer stops your next send from working
• "Ask again" now works after you switch wallets
